name: Setup Wizard ESC telemetry: Not used clears the stored protocol
step: Check that Not used on the ESC telemetry step clears the feature, the port and the stored protocol
rationale:
Not used on the Setup Wizard's ESC telemetry step cleared the ESC sensor feature bit and freed the port, but kept the
stored protocol. The firmware's validateAndFixConfig runs at every EEPROM write and at boot, and turns the feature back on
for protocol F.BUS with an FBUS or S.Port master port (config.c), so the step showed Used again at its next read.

The harness drives the real setup_wizard_esctelemetry.lua against a simulated flight controller, picks Not used on the
setup screen, and pins: the feature bit is cleared, the port is freed, the protocol is written as 0, and Discard writes
the protocol back.

--self-test removes the protocol reset and requires the protocol check to go red.
